about: Test set for the agent's extraction (session text -> SMART actions). Each expected action is found if all its regexes match the action's title, description or success measure. 'due' is checked within +/- 1 day. 'must_not' lists things that must never become an action (ideas they decided against, or invented work).

cases.description: The 2026-11-11 phone test script (a Wednesday in Bhutan): deadlines said as day names must count from today
cases.text:
[Mentor] Hi Pema, good to meet you. I read your notes. You run village walks and a homestay near Thimphu, and you're not sure who your guests really are. Is that right?
[Entrepreneur] Yes, that's right. Most bookings come from friends of friends, but I don't know why people choose us or how to describe the walk so the right people find it.
[Mentor] Let's start with your guests. How many guests have you had in the last two months?
[Entrepreneur] About twelve groups. Mostly young couples from Thimphu, and a few tourists from India.
[Mentor] Good. Before we talk about marketing, you need to hear it from them. Can you call some of them?
[Entrepreneur] Yes. I will call five recent guests and ask why they booked and what they liked most. I will finish that by Friday.
[Mentor] Perfect. And I will send you a short list of interview questions by tomorrow, so the calls are easy.
[Entrepreneur] Thank you, that helps a lot. What about the price? Right now I charge one thousand two hundred ngultrum per person for the walk and lunch.
[Mentor] That may be low for what you offer. Try two prices: keep one thousand two hundred for some bookings and try one thousand five hundred for others, then see which people accept.
[Entrepreneur] Okay. I will test both prices on my next ten bookings over the next two weeks.
[Mentor] Great. And I will send you my pricing sheet template by Wednesday, so you can track the results.
[Entrepreneur] And the description on Instagram? I think it's too long.
[Mentor] After your guest calls, rewrite it using the words your guests use. Keep it to three short sentences.
[Entrepreneur] I will rewrite the Instagram description by next Monday, after the interviews.
[Mentor] One more thing. I know a tour operator in Paro who looks for village experiences. I will introduce you to him by email this week.
[Entrepreneur] That would be wonderful. Thank you, Deki.
[Mentor] You're welcome. Let's meet again in two weeks to look at what the guests said and how the prices did.
[Entrepreneur] Sounds good. Talk then.
